title: Implement catalog_detail_cache component
description:
Implement catalog_detail_cache.py for project catalog-api using the README.md component API: export the complete nested POLICY, exact SOURCE and RATIONALE, and a working create_cache(clock).

Use the standing approved response-cache agreement retained under Beads memory key catalog-api.response-cache. Fully read it with:
bd recall 'catalog-api.response-cache'

This is a reference to the current agreement, so use the standing approval at implementation time. It applies because catalog_detail_cache is another catalog-api reader sharing the approved response-cache behavior, including the policy for absent lookups. Preserve all approved fields, values, types, source, and rationale.

This task depends on trial-yr6, which implements the initial catalog_cache component and retains the reusable agreement. Preserve catalog_cache.py, the generic engine, earlier components, and project history; add this reader as a sibling component.

Verify namespace, TTL boundary, eviction order and capacity, handling of absent lookups, and instance isolation according to the recalled policy. Add relevant component tests and run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
